scope: CAM-T1 v1: GPU evaluation of CAM-K2 v3 seeds 1 and 2 in CAM-K2-E3's V3 condition (no_lidar, 66 x 54 deg, CAM-K2 v2 treatments, blob_near rule): Stage A 24 traced cells (4 densities x 3 seeds) with a per-cell noninterference gate against CAM-K2-E3, after a 1-cell native identity; a 3-cell control (K=1/D=0 hook identity, d1 and cap20 smokes); Stage B 36 cells (free speed cap 2.5 and 2.0 m/s, one-step action delay; 115 and 205 bars x 3 seeds); 64 cells, caps 0.25 / 2.0 / 0.5 / 2.5 h per stage with rate gates, idle host; tools/camt1_run.py
